summary: Opening the Cancel action on sales order S00021 raised Odoo's "Cancel Sales Order" wizard; I clicked its "Cancel" button (the one with name action_cancel, next to "Send and cancel" and a Discard that just closes the wizard). The form now shows the status bar with "Cancelled" checked (Sales Order / Quotation Sent / Quotation all greyed out, and a "Set to Quotation" button now offered), heading still S00021 — so the sales order is cancelled. A confirmation email composer was part of the wizard (Recipients/Subject pre-filled with the cancellation notice addressed to fwod84-n1 Bench Customer), but the plain "Cancel" action was used rather than "Send and cancel".

values.statusbar_states: Cancelled (checked), Sales Order, Quotation Sent, Quotation
